patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.chiefComplaint: Left lower belly pain and fever
clinical.quoteLong: I've had a steady, achy pain low on the left side of my belly for two days, and now a fever. I'm not really hungry and my bowels have been off. It's tender right there when I press.
clinical.presentationShort: 58yo F — LLQ pain, localized tenderness, low-grade fever, altered bowel habit — acute diverticulitis.
clinical.presentationLong: 58-year-old female with two days of left-lower-quadrant pain, localized tenderness, a low-grade fever, and altered bowel habits — acute diverticulitis.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → CT abdomen/pelvis, labs, antibiotics, analgesia, bowel rest; watch for perforation/abscess.
diagnosis.why: Older adult + LLQ pain + fever = diverticulitis. CT confirms and rules out abscess/perforation.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, hand pressed to the lower-left belly, guarded
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 58-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: one hand pressed to the lower-left belly, guarding slightly. Expression: uncomfortable and tired. Clearly visible: a hand pressed to the lower-left abdomen. No text, no logos.
